I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate. I checked first that he's a member of that channel.

The answer comes from Priyanka's messages there about the carrier API outage on 2025-09-03. She said label printing stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note at 18:43 said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I told him the channel doesn't give a street address for Southgate. I also couldn't find a Tansley account profile in the shared files.
